display_name: Where the chain of command sits: the Kesmark district (theatre_pannonia)
source: game value: a fictional district on the air war's theatre (positions in km east and north of its origin); the kinds of post and office follow docs/research/CHAIN_OF_COMMAND_RESEARCH_2026-10.md
notes: The map the player's character moves on: the small city of Novo Varosd (the army's headquarters, the national air defence sector's bunker, the works), the town of Kesmark (the bridges the battery defends, the garrison commandant, civil defence, the police, the station, the sugar factory), five villages, the regiment's posts in the woods and fields, the radar posts on the hills, the air base. kind: city, town, village, industrial, civil (an office in a settlement), military_post, infrastructure, countryside. settlement: the city, town or village it is in ('' in the countryside); urban places suffer what utin_2018 §9.3 says of signals in a city. theatre_object: a theatre object it stands at (its position is taken from the object, and follows it when the object moves: the battery's command post moves with the battery).
